@@ -164,6 +164,22 @@ Backend and frontend work proceed in parallel when file ownership and dependenci
 
 Security, premium visual quality, and clarity/ease apply everywhere. Every flow must explain readiness, the next action and owner, required approvals, the verified outcome, and recovery. Use original Axiom branding and interaction principles inspired by Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Grok and Apple. Never substitute marketing language for tested capabilities. Preserve tenant boundaries, spending limits, genuine human approvals, uncertain outcomes and historical attempts.
 
+### Codex execution contract and plan-quality gates
+
+This master plan is the authoritative requirements and evidence ledger, **not** a blanket permission to perform work. Before starting any unit, read the current prioritized checklist, the relevant detailed parent section, the latest source-bound evidence and applicable authorization/spending/security restrictions. Do not treat a historic receipt, unchecked parent, proposed architecture, copied example, synthetic test or previous human approval as current production authority.
+
+For each unit, write a compact execution packet containing: (1) customer problem and user-visible outcome, (2) exact source/feature owner and dependencies, (3) current verified behavior and source revision, (4) proposed change and explicit non-goals, (5) trust/tenant/secret/financial/production boundaries, (6) success and negative acceptance tests, (7) local preview or real-environment proof appropriate to risk, (8) rollback/recovery, (9) estimated spend and required approvals, and (10) updated evidence link and next action. A feature is **done** only when its stated acceptance evidence exists; a passing mock or build is not a customer outcome.
+
+Maintain separate views, generated from this plan and linked evidence rather than competing copies: **product capability matrix** (implemented / local-only / simulated / planned / disabled / live-accepted); **dependency and decision register** (owner, alternatives, reason, reversibility, date); **current execution brief** (top unblocked tasks and exact gates); and **adoption inventory** (existing libraries, proposed tools, licenses, maintenance, network/telemetry behavior and explicit approval). Update these views only from verified sources, and never rewrite historical receipts to make progress appear newer.
+
+**Competitive differentiation acceptance:** demonstrate one genuine customer journey from request/intake through policy decision, independent approval, governed execution, observed outcome, audit record and recovery; prove at least one negative/refusal journey. Separately qualify multi-orchestrator contracts and customer-controlled offline operation before advertising them. Maintain a dated, evidence-linked comparison with Harness, Spacelift, env0 and Terraform/HCP, separating verified competitor features from Axiom's implemented, preview and planned features. Avoid claiming unique functionality without substantiation.
+
+**AI architecture acceptance:** agents propose and explain; the governance control plane decides and authorizes; narrow execution adapters perform effects; independent observations establish outcomes. Define versioned tool/action contracts, identity and tenant scope, least privilege, consent, policy evaluation, budget limits, idempotency, durable unknown outcomes, redaction, provenance and human override. Require offline/replayable evaluation sets for tool misuse, prompt injection, cross-tenant leakage, approval bypass, hallucinated success, rollback and token-cost/quality regressions. Reuse existing primitives and evaluate OPA/Conftest, OpenTelemetry, Promptfoo, Langfuse, Temporal and other candidates only after an inventory and isolated pilot; **do not install or replace frameworks by default**.
+
+**Workstream C tracking:** C1–C6 are six additional **future-scope** requirements beyond the original 15 A/B parents. Include them in the scope registry and future backlog with status **Planned / not authorized for implementation**, explicit dependencies and acceptance gates. Do not count them as completed, quietly omit them from progress reports, or imply the old 15-parent checklist covers them. When C implementation is separately authorized, promote selected units into the active execution board without displacing the original priorities.
+
+**Documentation quality:** keep the active execution brief concise and the historical log append-only; label superseded claims explicitly instead of silently deleting evidence. Every linked artifact must resolve, but link existence alone does not validate its contents or current-source relevance. Record any failed check, unavailable browser/host, missing approval or unverified external claim as an open gate rather than filling it with assumptions.
